remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: The frozen screen simultaneously shows 6 cargas encontradas, 25 registros por página, pages 1/2/3 and an enabled-looking next control.
remediation_actions.decision: Set pagination availability from the current total-record and page-size state so unavailable phantom pages are not exposed.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Set pagination available_pages to ceil(total_records / page_size) and derive next availability from the current page; with the observed 6 records and page size 25, only page 1 is available and next is unavailable.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Pagination QA verifies that page controls always match ceil(total_records / page_size); for the observed 6/25 state, only page 1 is actionable and no next-page action is available, while later pages appear automatically when current data requires them.

execution.desired_value: derive from ceil(total_records / page_size) and current_page

acceptance_check.expected: available pages and next state equal the values derived from current total_records, page_size and current_page

remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: At the frozen 1600x1000 viewport all ten observed headers including Acciones are visible while horizontal scrollbar chrome remains rendered below the six rows.
remediation_actions.decision: Hide the table horizontal scroll control when no horizontal overflow exists, while retaining automatic horizontal overflow whenever the table exceeds its container.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Hide table_horizontal_scroll when scrollWidth <= clientWidth and retain overflow auto so the same control becomes available whenever scrollWidth > clientWidth without removing columns or actions.
remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Table overflow QA verifies that no horizontal scrollbar is shown when all columns fit; when the table exceeds its container, horizontal access appears and every existing column and action remains reachable.

execution.desired_value: hidden when scrollWidth <= clientWidth; available through overflow auto when scrollWidth > clientWidth

acceptance_check.expected: hidden without horizontal overflow and available with real horizontal overflow
